_comment: 036 bright-field subset (Siemens star, 30 keV, FZP dr=200 nm, phi 155 um): ring-1 positions only (9). Input = drift-corrected per-pixel medians of 3 repeats (halves A = repeats 1,3,5 and B = 2,4,6, see d036/prep_036.py), background-subtracted (per-pixel median of dark-field direct frames), so dark_offset = 0. p = FZP focal length and CZP focal length are not measured values.
